_comment: Repairs for example sentences whose German half was clipped mid-phrase
while the English translation stayed complete — the dataset was cut at a
fixed column when it was extracted from its coursebook source, so learners
were reading fragments like 'Am Morgen mache ich Frühstück für' presented
Each entry is keyed by the headword (w) so it survives reordering; the
applier refuses to write if `from` no longer matches what is in the file,
which makes the whole patch idempotent and safe to re-run.
Rule for the replacement text: exactly one ' — ' separator (ExampleLine
splits on the first one), a complete German sentence before it, and an
English rendering after it that matches the German actually written.
